American Rebel Raises $135,000 via Convertible Note With GS Capital; Matures Jul 2027
data.description:
American Rebel Holdings entered into a Securities Purchase Agreement with GS Capital Partners, issuing a $135,000 convertible promissory note to support liquidity. The note has a $13,500 original issue discount, providing net proceeds of $121,500 before approximately $5,000 in expenses, and matures on Jul 13, 2027. Principal will be repaid in seven monthly installments starting 181 days after the Jul 31, 2026 issue date. The note is convertible at 75% of the lowest trading price over the five days before conversion; the company issued 59,000 commitment shares and reserved up to 3,701,799 shares for potential conversion.

Agreement details:

  • Agreement type: Convertible promissory note and securities purchase agreement
  • Counterparty: GS Capital Partners
  • Signed / Effective: Jul 31 2026 / same
  • Duration / Termination: Until Jul 13 2027
  • Reason: Bolster liquidity and financing flexibility

Original SEC Filing: AMERICAN REBEL HOLDINGS INC [ AREB ] - 8-K - Aug. 07, 2026

Atlassian Stock Jumps 36% as Cloud Growth Accelerates
data.description:
Atlassian rose 35.60% intraday after reporting fourth-quarter revenue of $1,766 million, up 28% and past the $1,663 million analysts expected. Cloud revenue, the company's growth engine, rose 31%, an acceleration, and non-GAAP earnings of $1.87 a share beat estimates.

Atlassian posted GAAP operating income of $211 million, a 12% margin, after an operating loss a year earlier, and its non-GAAP operating margin widened to 36% from 24%. Remaining performance obligations, a gauge of contracted future revenue, grew 44% to $4.8 billion, and free cash flow was $475 million. Subscription ARR reached $6.6 billion, up 23%.

There was a notable insider signal too. CEO and co-founder Mike Cannon-Brookes said he plans to buy up to $250 million of Atlassian stock on the open market.

For the coming year, Atlassian guided to cloud revenue growth of about 25.5%, though total growth will slow to roughly 13%. The drag is Data Center, which the company is discontinuing by 2029, with revenue there expected to fall about 17% as earlier contract pull-forward and cloud migrations weigh on the segment.

Embecta Corp. 2026: Revenue $271.7M, EPS $0.36— 10-Q Summary
data.description:
Embecta Corp. reported results for the 2026 quarter with revenue of $271.7M and diluted EPS of $0.36, down from $295.5M and $0.78, respectively, in the prior-year quarter; net income was $21.1M versus $45.5M a year earlier.

Financial Highlights

MetricCurrent quarterPrior year quarterYoY change
Revenue¹$271.7M$295.5M(8.1%)
Net income²$21.1M$45.5M(53.6%)
Diluted EPS³$0.36$0.78(53.8%)

¹ Reported as “Revenues”. ² Reported as “Net Income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted income per common share”.

Business Highlights

  • Revenue decline of roughly 8% quarter-over-quarter and about 7.6% year-to-date was driven by lower volume and pricing pressure despite the contribution from the Owen Mumford acquisition.
  • Channel commoditization and stronger distributor purchasing power continued to pressure pricing, shifting demand toward volume-based procurement.
  • Completed acquisition of Owen Mumford on May 15, 2026 to expand the auto-injector and chronic-care portfolio and broaden global product reach.
  • Management initiated a cost-structure and footprint review, began brand transition work, started an ERP implementation and built inventory to mitigate supply disruptions.
  • Facing demand shifts from new diabetes therapies and changing pen/insulin trends, the company is pursuing B2B drug-delivery growth (Aidaptus) and cross-selling opportunities.

Original SEC Filing: Embecta Corp. [ EMBC ] - 10-Q - Aug. 07, 2026

data.title: BancFirst Corp /OK/ Q2 2026: Revenue $187.5M, EPS $1.96— 10-Q Summary
data.description:
BancFirst Corp /OK/ reported second-quarter 2026 results with revenue of $187.5M and net income of $66.7M, driving diluted EPS of $1.96— all higher versus the year-ago quarter, according to the company's 10-Q filing.

Financial Highlights

  • Revenue was $187.5M (Net interest income $133.5M + Noninterest income $53.9M), compared with $169.3M in Q2 2025; YoY change 10.7%.
  • Net income was $66.7M, compared with $62.3M in the year-ago quarter; YoY change 7.0%.
  • Diluted EPS was $1.96, compared with $1.85 in the year-ago quarter; YoY change 5.9%.

Business Highlights

  • Revenue growth was driven by roughly 10% higher net interest income, supported by increased loan volume and growth in earning assets.
  • Deposit mix shifted toward sweep accounts and higher noninterest-bearing deposits while core deposits remained stable and grew modestly.
  • Noninterest income benefited from higher trust revenue, service charges, card interchange and BOLI gains.
  • Noninterest expense increased, largely due to higher salaries and benefits and costs related to other real estate owned (OREO).
  • Loans posted modest growth with commercial real estate leading internal expansion; nonaccrual loans and OREO balances increased during the quarter.

Original SEC Filing: BANCFIRST CORP /OK/ [ BANF ] - 10-Q - Aug. 07, 2026
